data.name: Select Technologies Limited
data.description: Select Technologies Limited (“the Company”) was incorporated in Pakistan on October 13, 2021, as a private limited company under the Companies Act, 2017. The Company is a subsidiary of Air Link Communication Limited, and is principally engaged in the manufacturing, distribution and retail of mobile devices, home appliances, information technology products, and other allied products in Pakistan.
